name: MPI
recent: MPI 于 2026 年 11 月 19 日公布截至 2026 年 9 月 30 日止季度业绩，并宣布派发每股 10 仙的中期单层股息。同期，雇员公积金局（EPF）连续多日申报持股变动。公司于 11 月 4 日召开第 65 届常年股东大会，所有决议均以投票方式通过。
notable: 宣布每股 10 仙的中期单层股息，除息日为 2026 年 12 月 3 日，派发日为 2026 年 12 月 17 日。
公布截至 2026 年 9 月 30 日止季度业绩。
第 65 届常年股东大会于 2026 年 11 月 4 日举行，所有决议均获通过。
risks: 雇员公积金局（EPF）在 2026 年 10 月至 11 月期间多次申报持股变动。
earnings: 最近一季（截至 2026 年 6 月 30 日）营收为 MYR 736.637 million，环比增长 13.1%，同比增长 30.6%；净利为 MYR 44.228 million，环比增长 31.3%，同比增长 1.6%；净利率为 6.0%，高于上一季的 5.2%。

recent_en: MPI announced its quarterly results for the period ended 30 September 2026 on 19 November 2026 and declared an interim single-tier dividend of 10 sen per share. Meanwhile, the Employees Provident Fund Board (EPF) filed multiple consecutive changes in its shareholdings. The company held its 65th Annual General Meeting on 4 November, where all resolutions were passed by poll.
notable_en: Declared an interim single-tier dividend of 10 sen per share, with ex-date on 3 December 2026 and payment date on 17 December 2026.
Announced quarterly results for the period ended 30 September 2026.
Held its 65th Annual General Meeting on 4 November 2026; all resolutions were passed.
risks_en: The Employees Provident Fund Board (EPF) filed multiple changes in its shareholdings between October and November 2026.
earnings_en: For the latest quarter ended 30 June 2026, revenue was MYR 736.637 million, up 13.1% QoQ and 30.6% YoY; net income was MYR 44.228 million, up 31.3% QoQ and 1.6% YoY; net margin was 6.0%, compared with 5.2% in the previous quarter.
